body: Pathology foundation models improve transferable representation learning for histopathology, but recent gains often rely on encoders with hundreds of millions of parameters and high inference cost. We propose TAP-Path, a task-adaptive compression framework that directly restructures a pretrained Virchow2 encoder rather than distilling it into a separate student. TAP-Path combines validation-driven transformer-block selection, physical removal of redundant blocks, input-adaptive patch-token pruning, multi-depth feature recovery, and a lightweight gated task head. The final model retains 24 of 32 transformer blocks and 70% of patch tokens after pruning, reducing encoder parameters by 24.96% (631.24M to 473.70M) and analytical encoder compute by 35.20% (340.13G to 220.40G FLOPs). Across three task-head optimization seeds, TAP-Path achieved 87.98 ± 0.067% test accuracy, 81.26 ± 0.49% balanced accuracy, and 82.38 ± 0.48% macro-F1 on a 32-class histopathology benchmark, compared with 86.89% for full Virchow2 and 87.67% for UNI2-h. TAP-Path achieved a Brier score of 0.1800 ± 0.0005 and failure-detection AUROC of 0.9047 ± 0.0060. A validation-only rare-aware objective improved rare-class balanced accuracy in a secondary operating analysis. Frozen external evaluation on 433 CPTAC samples yielded 91.22 ± 0.83% accuracy and 91.10 ± 0.81% balanced accuracy. These results show that task-adaptive structural and token sparsification can improve the accuracy-efficiency trade-off of large pathology foundation models while preserving reliability under internal and external evaluation.
summaryZh: 本文提出针对病理学基础模型（如Virchow2）的任务自适应压缩框架TAP-Path。该方法无需蒸馏，直接重构预训练编码器，结合剪枝Transformer块与动态Patch Token剪枝。实验显示编码器参数减少24.96%，计算量降低35.20%，且在32类病理基准与外部数据集上均取得优于全量模型和同类模型的分类准确率，显著提升了病理大模型的推理效率与可靠性。

glossary.explanationZh: 任务自适应结构化剪枝，根据特定任务需求对模型网络结构（如Transformer块）进行选择性裁剪。
Token剪枝，在输入层或中间层剔除冗余或不重要的视觉/文本Token以减少计算量。
组织病理学，通过显微镜观察切片组织结构来进行疾病诊断的医学学科。
门控任务头，一种带门控机制的轻量级任务特定预测头，用于增强特征融合。
布里尔分数，用于衡量概率预测准确性与校准程度的评估指标，数值越低越好。
